name: Dvizhenie serdca
source:
Alexey and Angelina are a great couple, but a problem has ripened in their relationship. Trying to provide for his family, Alexei spends too much time at work. He is rarely at home and does not notice that his girlfriend is suffering because of this. And then the moment comes when he comes home, he discovers that Angelina has left, but left a strange note ...
You have to figure out the situation, understand what happened and help the protagonist make difficult choices. In your hands is the fate of two young people!

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1261570/]Steam[/url]]
